newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B index ends up on rebound.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B index ends up on rebound.

text.p: Shanghai's B share market closed up on Wednesday on a technical rebound led by shares with a heavy weighting on the index in line with the rises on the A share market, brokers said.
The B index gained 0.511 points or 0.82 percent to 63.167 points, on volume of 18.4 million shares worth $8.6 million, against $8.3 million on Tuesday.
The A share index rose 14.089 points or 1.45 percent to finish at 984.078 on volume of 305.8 million shares worth 3.0 billion yuan, up from Tuesday's 2.8 billion.
Brokers said the A share rises in the afternoon session gave the market some confidence, but selling pressure at high levels was still heavy.
"Speculative institutional buying has been the main support for the market recently," one broker said. "Technical charts have improved to some extent, but follow-up buying remians limited."
"Most investors are waiting for results of a major meeting about the B shares market in Nanjing beginning on Wednesday," he added.
"The index will continue to consolidate around the 63-point level in the short term," a second broker said.
Of 43 B shares, 40 traded, with 19 up, 10 flat and 11 down.
Textile machinery maker Erfangji was the star on speculative buying, rising $0.008 or 5.63 percent to $0.150 on volume of 26,000 shares.
Market giant Shanghai Tyre followed on institutional support, brokers said.
It ended up $0.020 or 4.46 percent to $0.468 on volume of 854,500 shares.

Blue chip Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor was the most active share on heavy institutional selling on investors' jitters over its results, but bargain-hunting was also active after sharp losses in the past few days, brokers said.
It ended flat at $0.486 on volume of 3.3 million shares.

Shanghai's A share market extended early gains following the breach of a key resistance level, but further rises were unlikely with market sentiment cautious ahead of the long Chinese lunar new year holiday, brokers said.

The A index climbed 14.089 points or 1.45 percent to 984.078 points on volume of 305.8 million shares worth 3.0 billion yuan. The SSE 30 blue-chip index moved up 56.269 points or 2.25 percent to 2552.180 points.
United Agriculture was the star on institutional buying, surging 0.71 yuan or 10 percent to its limit-up of 7.81 yuan on volume of 1.0 million shares.
